extension.description: ZX Spectrum Next emulator and debugger right inside VS Code: stepping through sjasmplus source, conditional breakpoints, breakpoints on interrupts and NEXTREG, memory, emulator screen.
launch.sld: Debug information file from sjasmplus (--sld). Without it, debugging is limited to the disassembly.
launch.sourceRoot: Folder that source paths in the SLD are relative to (default: the folder of the SLD file).
launch.stopOnEntry: Stop at the program's first instruction.
launch.machine: Emulated machine (machines other than the Next need an SD card with ROMs).
launch.sdImage: SD card image (.img). Without it, the program sees its own folder through esxDOS.
launch.esxdosRoot: Folder the program sees through esxDOS when there is no SD card (default: the program's folder).
launch.rewind: Step Back – the emulator remembers the last 10 seconds. The instruction trace slows emulation down (by about a quarter on a Next at 28 MHz).
snippet.label: MB Maniax Next Debugger: Next program (sjasmplus)
snippet.description: Runs a sjasmplus program (.nex with .sld debug information) in the ZX Spectrum Next emulator.
config.serverPath: Path to mbx-next-server (empty = the server bundled with the extension).
config.language: Language of the extension (messages, emulator screen and Next panel). "auto" = the VS Code display language if it is not English, otherwise the system language, otherwise English. Takes effect with the next debug session; open panels are rebuilt.
config.language.autoDescription: VS Code language if it is not English, otherwise the system language, otherwise English.
launch.magicBreakpoint: Stop on the CSpect BREAK instruction (sjasmplus --zxnext=cspect: FD 00; DD 01) and on the ZEsarUX ED FF. Without it, DD 01 behaves as LD BC,nn.
launch.wpmem: Watchpoints from sjasmplus WPMEM comments (; WPMEM [addr[,size[,access]]]). Needs SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM in the source.
launch.logpoints: Logpoints from sjasmplus LOGPOINT comments (; LOGPOINT text ${expression}). Needs SLDOPT COMMENT LOGPOINT in the source.
launch.assertions: Assertions from sjasmplus ASSERTION comments (; ASSERTION expression) – stops when the expression is false. Needs SLDOPT COMMENT ASSERTION in the source.
config.reloadOnSave: While debugging, after saving an assembler source (.asm, .a80, .z80, .s, .inc) from the workspace, rebuild the program (preLaunchTask) and reload it without ending the debug session – like the Rebuild and Reload command.
launch.boot: "nextzxos": boot NextZXOS from the SD card and let it start the program (the program and its folder are copied to the card first). Without sdImage the NextZXOS working card is used; NextZXOS is not part of the debugger and is downloaded from specnext.com.
launch.cardFolder: With boot "nextzxos": the program's folder on the SD card (default /MBX/<program name>).
launch.autorun: With boot "nextzxos": NextZXOS starts the program by itself; false opens the Browser in the program's folder.
launch.syncBack: With boot "nextzxos": after the session, copy the files the program created or changed on the card back to its folder (esxdosRoot). Files deleted on the card are only listed.
config.nextzxos.url: Official NextZXOS distribution for emulators (zip) that Download NextZXOS fetches. NextZXOS is not part of the debugger.
config.nextzxos.sha256: SHA-256 of that zip; a download that does not match is refused.
config.nextzxos.size: Size of that zip in bytes; a download that does not match is refused.
config.nextzxos.cardReset: When the NextZXOS working card (shared by all projects) returns to its downloaded state.
config.nextzxos.cardReset.never: Only with the command Reset NextZXOS Working Card.
config.nextzxos.cardReset.afterSession: After every debug session that booted from it.
snippet.nextzxosDescription: Boot NextZXOS from the SD card and debug the program it starts
